_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: infinite detail as the uncomputable — the middle-third removed forever yields an infinite set of measure zero: a short seed whose full run never halts, more points than the integers in less than no length

the fractional/non-integer identity — dimension refuses to be a whole number; log(3)/log(2) = 1.585 names a thing that is neither line nor plane, an identity that lives BETWEEN the categories the ruler was built to enforce

the Mandelbrot boundary as the infinitely-queer edge — the set is trivial to state (does z=z^2+c escape?) and infinitely costly to bound; the coastline never resolves, forever generative under any zoom, the uncomputable made walkable

self-similarity as the recursion of the self — the golden-angle spiral grows the whole out of copies of itself; the organism IS its own generating rule, morphology as fixed point of a map (the Turing move: the living form carries its recursion)

the edge between order and chaos rendered as terrain — each point in parameter space colored by whether nearby paths converge or diverge; stability and sensitivity woven at every scale, the lambda-edge thesis drawn as a place
